entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Delicious food, fluffy sheets...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess home is what you make[n]of it... even in this abandoned[n]building of all places.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, take care of me like[n]this back home too, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, uh... I wanted to ask you something.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Remember the tail end of Maruki's[n]Palace, when I was actually flying?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...That wasn't a dream, right?
It sure wasn't.
Why do you ask?
Oh, I dunno...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I thought so.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I still can't figure out how that[n]was possible in the first place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I mean, it's not anything important...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But I still can't figure out how that[n]was possible in the first place.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: C'mon, don't blow me off here!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...I mean, I'm pretty sure it really did[n]happen, but I still can't figure out[n]how it was even possible.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, this is just a theory, but...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't you still have that Star[n]Jose gave you?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, it's...!
The Star's lost its luster...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This was shining the last time[n]you looked at it, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So it really was the effect of the Star...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh— Well of course it was, now that[n]I think about it!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no other way that the idea of[n]a cat converting into a helicopter could[n]suddenly become a common cognition.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, we're through with the Metaverse,[n]and it only happened in the most[n]extreme of emergencies...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So I have a feeling that won't be[n]happening again anytime soon.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I couldn't say this[n]in front of all the[n]others, but...
entries.uk: Я не могла сказати[n]цього при всіх, але...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to see you,[n]privately. Can I come[n]by Leblanc tomorrow?
entries.uk: Я хочу побачитися[n]наодинці. Можна завтра[n]зайти до «Леблану»?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Hey, do you think[n]we could meet again[n]tomorrow evening?
entries.uk: Слухай, а можна нам[n]знову побачитися[n]завтра ввечері?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If it's all right[n]with you, we have[n]much to talk about...
entries.uk: Якщо ти не проти, нам[n]треба багато про що[n]поговорити...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, let's meet again[n]tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We can celebrate your[n]getting released, just[n]the two of us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I have something for[n]you too. I'll see[n]you at your place?
entries.uk: У мене для тебе дещо[n]є. Побачимося в тебе?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The fun isn't over yet.[n]Tomorrow's the big day.
entries.uk: Веселощі ще не скінчилися.[n]Завтра великий день.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I have a gift too.[n]Let's meet just the[n]two of us.
entries.uk: У мене теж є подарунок.[n]Зустріньмося лише[n]вдвох.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I've been waiting[n]for you to get home!
entries.uk: Я так чекала, коли[n]ти повернешся додому!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I have so much I want to talk to[n]you about. I'd love to see you...
entries.uk: Мені стільки всього хочеться тобі[n]розповісти. Я б так хотіла тебе побачити...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Do you want[n]to hang out[n]tomorrow night?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Are you home? If there's[n]nothing wrong with you, then[n]let me come over and examine you.
entries.uk: Ти вдома? Якщо з тобою все[n]гаразд, дозволь мені прийти[n]й оглянути тебе.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Just kidding. I just[n]wanted to see you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can I come over[n]tomorrow after work?
entries.uk: Можна завтра зайти[n]до тебе після роботи?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I got a call from school that you[n]returned safely. I'm so glad...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I want to talk to you in person,[n]so are you free tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I can make the trip to meet[n]you somewhere if you want.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Exclusive: [f 4 3]'s[n]Tearful Release!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: How's it feel to be free?[n]You better come see me...
entries.uk: Як воно — бути на волі?[n]Гляди мені, зайди...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Or I'll just go to[n]your place tomorrow.
entries.uk: Бо інакше я завтра[n]сама до тебе прийду.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I heard that you've[n]returned. Welcome back...
entries.uk: Я чула, що ти[n]повернувся. З поверненням...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'd like to see you. Do you have[n]any plans for tomorrow evening?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm glad you made it back...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm sorry I couldn't go meet[n]with you today.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'd like to see you tomorrow night,[n]if that's okay...
What should I do tomorrow?
I can only spend time with[n]one person... What should[n]I do tomorrow?
entries.uk: Я можу провести час лише[n]з однією людиною... Що[n]робити завтра?

entries.en: Spend time with Makoto.
Spend time with Haru.
Spend time with Ann.
Spend time with Futaba.
Spend time with Chihaya.
Spend time with Takemi.
Spend time with Kawakami.
Spend time with Ohya.
Spend time with Hifumi.
Spend time with Sumire.
Don't respond.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thanks.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll stop by when the[n]shop is about to close.[n]Well, good night.
entries.uk: Я зайду, коли кав'ярня[n]вже зачинятиметься.[n]Що ж, добраніч.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Perfect! I'll see you[n]tomorrow then!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yay! I'll come by[n]tomorrow night.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Niiight!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yay! I'll be invading[n]your place tomorrow then.
entries.uk: Ура! Тоді завтра я[n]вторгаюся до тебе.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Time to make like a tree!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Really? OK, if you insist...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I look forward to[n]seeing you tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Glad to hear it.[n]I'm looking forward[n]to tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I think I'll come visit[n]you at night, then.
entries.uk: Тоді, мабуть, я прийду[n]до тебе ввечері.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I look forward to[n]tomorrow, Master.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Really? OK, then I'll stop[n]by in the evening.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: See you tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Really? Would that be all right?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well, if you insist...[n]I'll see you tomorrow.[n]Good night.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you! I'll see you[n]tomorrow then.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Good night.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You never change, do you?
entries.uk: Ти зовсім не міняєшся, еге ж?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's go to bed. You're[n]working at the shop from tomorrow[n]onward, right?
entries.uk: Ну ж бо, ходімо спати. Ти ж від завтра[n]працюєш у кав'ярні, так?
